notes.design_point: DORMANT CHALLENGER (not a design change): adaptive/semantic partitioning stays FORBIDDEN per 11m until fixed-uniform carries at P1c. If patch16 carries, SCPaT-shape (semantic units + interaction structure) becomes the named follow-up arm — tested against the carried fixed-uniform baseline, never against stock alone.
notes.relevance: The explicit alternative to our fixed-uniform discipline. Recorded as the challenger to beat, in order.
notes.title: Rethinking Patch Based Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Semantic Structured Partitioning

notes.design_point: DORMANT LOSS ARM (PIPELINE-STANDS amended, not reopened): while members are skill-less, regularizing residual structure is wasted. IF P1 ever passes in some family, the first loss upgrade is a cross-variable structural regularizer on forecast residuals — before any new body or head. Until then parked.
notes.relevance: First credible amendment to the single-term loss since the audit: structure the FORECAST residuals, not the historical inputs.
notes.title: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting needs Cross Variable Loss

notes.design_point: DORMANT (behind P1c): multi-scale patching + latent consistency penalties enter only as a follow-up if single-scale patch16 carries. No multi-scale now (redundancy risk noted in the paper itself).
notes.relevance: Multi-scale is the second patch axis after fixed-uniform carries. Channel-independent framing converges with our row-per-channel choice.
notes.title: Structured Latent Space Modeling over Multi-Scale Temporal Patches for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting

notes.design_point: DORMANT P5-adjacent: constant-cost streaming + future-known covariates. Our stream has NO future-known covariates (only time features), so the applicable lesson is the recurrent constant-per-step discipline for deployment — relevant when (not before) a carried model needs shipping.
notes.relevance: Deployment-side: streaming discipline + asymmetric variate mixing as a second witness for channel-separated processing.
notes.title: TiRex-2: Generalizing TiRex to Multivariate Data and Streaming

notes.design_point: B3 SUPPORT grows (B3 stays PARKED): mixture post-processing + CRPS training objective, univariate — pairs with 2606.30037 (heads dominate). If B3 unparks, the readout spec is mixture-head + CRPS training, not point-head + MSE.
notes.relevance: Second witness for readout-over-body on the probabilistic side: densities and calibration from the head, not the backbone.
notes.title: TEMPER: Temporal Encoder-Masked Probabilistic Ensemble Regressor for Time-Series Forecasting

notes.design_point: EXCLUDED with reason: irregular sampling with informative missingness — our stream is regular bars. Filter working as intended; no design impact.
notes.relevance: None (domain mismatch). Recorded to show the exclusion, not the inclusion.
notes.title: A Hybrid Attention Model Learning Unified Time-aware Patch Representation for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
